data.name: Spike Factory
targeting_extra: With Smart Spikes (x-2-x path3): Close, Smart, Set Target, Automatic added
Normal = random placement on track in range
data.crosspath_rule: Standard BTD6: one path to tier 5, a second path up to tier 2, third path locked at 0.

1.name: Bigger Stacks
1.text: New piles pierce 5->10 (Carpet of Spikes 10->15; Perma-Spike bonus +35, 50->85). No radius change.

1.name: White Hot Spikes
1.text: New spikes become Normal damage (pops Frozen and Lead).

1.name: Spiked Balls
1.text: Dispenses spiked balls instead of piles: 2 dmg, +3 Ceramic, +1 Fortified, pierce 11.

1.name: Spiked Mines
1.text: Mines explode when depleted or expired: 30 radius (40 with Long Reach), pierce 30, 10 Explosion dmg (+2 Ceramic, +3 Fortified), ignites non-Purple bloons (10 per 2s for 6.05s).

1.name: Super Mines
1.text: Produces mines half as often (every 3.5s), 50 dmg, pierce 18. Each depleted spike causes a non-burning mini explosion; expiry gives a huge burning explosion (1000 dmg, +500 Ceramic, +250 Fortified, 60 bloons, radius 100/133); burn 2500 per 2s for up to 6.05s. Pops any type.

2.name: MOAB SHREDR
2.text: +7 MOAB-class damage per spike, 40 per pile (54 with MKs), 80 with Bigger Stacks (99 with MKs).

2.name: Spike Storm
2.text: Ability: scatters spike piles over all lanes in clusters of 4 piles every 0.04s for 2s (204 piles; 208 every 4th use); randomly distributed by track area; piles last 9-11s; cd 50s; no attack speed buffs affect it. Crosspaths: Bigger Stacks +5 pierce, White Hot Spikes Normal damage, Long Reach lifetime x2 (18-22s), Smart Spikes only active lanes.

2.name: Carpet of Spikes
2.text: Passive Spike Storm every 15s (identical to ability, both cannot fire simultaneously); all spikes +2 damage (3 dmg, +7 MOAB-class) and +5 pierce (10; 15 with 1-5-0); main attack +100% speed (0.525s) and range 34->50; storm piles last 18-22s (36-44s with 0-5-1) and can persist 1 round.

3.name: Long Reach
3.text: Range 34->42, pile lifespan 50->100s. Crosspath: Spike Storm/Carpet spikes last 2x; Mines blast radius ~+33%.

3.name: Smart Spikes
3.text: Start-of-round buff: 4x attack speed for 3s (absorbable by Lych). Adds Close/Smart/Set Target/Automatic targeting. Crosspath Spike Storm/Carpet only drops on lanes with bloons and more spikes if triggered during buff.

3.name: Long Life Spikes
3.text: New blue caltrop-like piles last up to 140s, carry over 1 round (max 2 rounds); round-start 4x speed; 4 extra targeting options.

3.name: Deadly Spikes
3.text: Damage 1->3; piles carry over 2 rounds (3 max); still 140s.

3.name: Perma-Spike
3.text: Piles produced ~3.46x slower (1.75->6.06s), 10 dmg per spike, pierce 50 (85 with 1-0-5), last 300s, carry 3 rounds; round-start 4x boost lasts 10s. Spikes preserved on save load.

paragon.name: Mega Massive Munitions Factory
paragon.requirement: Super Mines, Carpet of Spikes and Perma-Spike on map at once; absorbs other Spike Factories; degree 1-100.
paragon.effect: Deploys giant spiked mines in radius lasting up to 5 rounds that split into 10 smaller spike piles on explosion. Same targeting as Smart Spikes. Permanent carpet of spikes on track passively damages all bloons map-wide (like Spirit of the Forest vines). Ability Controlled Burst: 4x main attack speed for 15s, once per round. Ability Spikeageddon: launches land mines at roughly equal intervals along each path, explode on contact (massive damage, release 3 smaller piles); reactivating detonates existing mines. Mine count depends on track length/number of paths. Exact numbers not captured.
